test_suite.feature_description: This feature encompasses a thorough testing suite for the login page located at http://localhost:8000. It includes 26 distinct test scenarios covering performance, security, accessibility, functional correctness, input validation, and robust error handling to ensure a reliable and secure user authentication process.

scenarios.name: Successful User Login
scenarios.description: Verify that a registered user can successfully log in with valid credentials.

steps.text: the login page is accessible at http://localhost:8000
I have a valid username and password
I enter my valid username in the username field
I enter my valid password in the password field
I click the login button
I should be redirected to the user dashboard
I should see a welcome message with my username

expected_results: User is successfully authenticated.
User is redirected to the correct post-login page.
A personalized welcome message is displayed.

scenarios.name: Login with Invalid Credentials
scenarios.description: Verify that an error message is displayed when a user attempts to log in with invalid credentials.

steps.text: the login page is accessible at http://localhost:8000
I have an invalid username or password
I enter an invalid username in the username field
I enter an invalid password in the password field
I click the login button
I should remain on the login page
an error message indicating 'Invalid username or password' is displayed

expected_results: User is not authenticated.
User remains on the login page.
An informative error message is displayed.

scenarios.name: Login with Empty Credentials
scenarios.description: Verify that the system prevents login attempts with empty username and password fields and displays appropriate validation messages.

steps.text: the login page is accessible at http://localhost:8000
I leave the username field empty
I leave the password field empty
I click the login button
I should remain on the login page
a validation message indicating 'Username is required' is displayed next to the username field
a validation message indicating 'Password is required' is displayed next to the password field

expected_results: Login attempt is blocked.
User remains on the login page.
Appropriate validation messages are shown for both empty fields.

scenarios.name: Login with Only Username Provided
scenarios.description: Verify that the system prevents login attempts when only the username is provided and the password field is empty.

steps.text: the login page is accessible at http://localhost:8000
I have a valid username
I enter my valid username in the username field
I leave the password field empty
I click the login button
I should remain on the login page
a validation message indicating 'Password is required' is displayed next to the password field

expected_results: Login attempt is blocked.
User remains on the login page.
A validation message for the empty password field is displayed.

scenarios.name: Login with Only Password Provided
scenarios.description: Verify that the system prevents login attempts when only the password is provided and the username field is empty.

steps.text: the login page is accessible at http://localhost:8000
I have a valid password
I leave the username field empty
I enter my valid password in the password field
I click the login button
I should remain on the login page
a validation message indicating 'Username is required' is displayed next to the username field

expected_results: Login attempt is blocked.
User remains on the login page.
A validation message for the empty username field is displayed.

scenarios.name: Test Scenario: Empty Username and Password Fields
scenarios.description: Verify that the login form displays appropriate validation messages when both username and password fields are left empty.

steps.text: The user is on the login page http://localhost:8000
The user clicks the login button without entering any credentials
The system should display a validation message for the username field indicating it is required
The system should display a validation message for the password field indicating it is required

expected_results: An error message is displayed next to the username input field, stating 'Username is required'.
An error message is displayed next to the password input field, stating 'Password is required'.
The user is not logged in.

scenarios.name: Test Scenario: Invalid Username Format
scenarios.description: Verify that the login form displays an appropriate validation message when the username field is entered with an invalid format (e.g., special characters not allowed).

steps.text: The user is on the login page http://localhost:8000
The user enters 'invalid-user!' in the username field and a valid password
The user clicks the login button
The system should display a validation message for the username field indicating an invalid format

expected_results: An error message is displayed next to the username input field, stating 'Invalid username format. Please use only letters and numbers.' (or similar based on defined format).
The user is not logged in.

scenarios.name: Keyboard Navigation for Login Form
scenarios.description: Verify that the login form can be fully navigated and interacted with using only a keyboard, ensuring users who cannot use a mouse can still log in.

steps.text: I am on the login page at http://localhost:8000
I use the Tab key to navigate through interactive elements
I can reach the username input field
I can reach the password input field
I can reach the login button
I press Enter on the login button
The login process is initiated without requiring a mouse click

expected_results: Focus indicator is clearly visible on each interactive element as it is tabbed to.
Tab order follows a logical sequence (e.g., username, password, login button).
Users can successfully submit the form using the Enter key on the login button.

scenarios.name: Screen Reader Compatibility for Login Form
scenarios.description: Ensure that a screen reader can correctly interpret and announce all elements of the login form, including labels, input fields, and the login button, to visually impaired users.

steps.text: I am on the login page at http://localhost:8000 with a screen reader activated
The page loads
The screen reader announces the purpose of the page (e.g., 'Login page')
I navigate to the username input field
The screen reader announces 'username' or a similar descriptive label
I navigate to the password input field
The screen reader announces 'password' or a similar descriptive label
I navigate to the login button
The screen reader announces 'Login' or 'Sign In'

expected_results: All form elements have associated and programmatically linked labels.
Input fields are correctly identified by their labels.
Buttons are clearly identified by their accessible name.

scenarios.name: Sufficient Color Contrast for Login Form Elements
scenarios.description: Verify that the color contrast between text and background on the login form meets WCAG AA standards, ensuring readability for users with low vision or color blindness.

steps.text: I am on the login page at http://localhost:8000
I inspect the color contrast of the text and background for all visible elements
The contrast ratio for text within input fields meets or exceeds 4.5:1
The contrast ratio for the login button text against its background meets or exceeds 4.5:1
The contrast ratio for any placeholder text in input fields meets or exceeds 4.5:1

expected_results: Text is easily readable against its background.
No essential information is conveyed solely through color.

scenarios.name: ARIA Attributes for Form Structure and Input Types
scenarios.description: Check for the correct use of ARIA attributes to enhance the semantic structure of the login form for assistive technologies.

steps.text: I am on the login page at http://localhost:8000
I inspect the HTML structure of the login form
The form element has an appropriate role, if necessary (e.g., role='form')
The input fields have appropriate `type` attributes (e.g., `type='text'`, `type='password'`)
The login button has an appropriate `type` attribute (e.g., `type='button'`, `type='submit'`) and an accessible name

expected_results: Form elements are semantically clear for assistive technologies.
Input fields are correctly identified by their type, aiding browser and assistive technology behavior.

scenarios.name: Focus Management on Login Error
scenarios.description: Verify that when a login error occurs, focus is appropriately managed to guide the user to correct the issue.

steps.text: I am on the login page at http://localhost:8000
I have entered invalid credentials
I click the login button
An error message is displayed indicating the login failure
Focus is programmatically moved to the first field that requires correction (e.g., username or password)

expected_results: Users are clearly informed of the login error.
Assistive technology users are directed to the input field that needs attention, facilitating correction.

scenarios.name: Attempt Login with Invalid Credentials
scenarios.description: Verify that the login page prevents unauthorized access when incorrect username and password combinations are provided.

steps.text: The user is on the login page at http://localhost:8000
The user enters an invalid username 'invalid_user'
The user enters an invalid password 'wrong_password'
The user clicks the login button
The user should not be logged in
An appropriate error message should be displayed indicating invalid credentials

expected_results: User remains on the login page.
An error message like 'Invalid username or password.' is displayed.

scenarios.name: Check for SQL Injection Vulnerability in Username Field
scenarios.description: Test if the username input field is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks by attempting to inject malicious SQL code.

steps.text: The user is on the login page at http://localhost:8000
The user enters a SQL injection payload in the username field, e.g., ' OR '1'='1
The user enters any password
The user clicks the login button
The user should not be logged in with unauthorized access
The system should not execute the injected SQL query or return an error indicating a database issue

expected_results: User remains on the login page.
No successful login occurs.
No database errors are exposed.

scenarios.name: Check for SQL Injection Vulnerability in Password Field
scenarios.description: Test if the password input field is vulnerable to SQL injection attacks by attempting to inject malicious SQL code.

steps.text: The user is on the login page at http://localhost:8000
The user enters a valid or invalid username
The user enters a SQL injection payload in the password field, e.g., ' OR '1'='1
The user clicks the login button
The user should not be logged in with unauthorized access
The system should not execute the injected SQL query or return an error indicating a database issue

expected_results: User remains on the login page.
No successful login occurs.
No database errors are exposed.

scenarios.name: Verify Password Field Masking
scenarios.description: Ensure that the password field masks the entered characters to prevent shoulder surfing and unauthorized viewing of the password.

steps.text: The user is on the login page at http://localhost:8000
The user enters characters into the password input field
The entered characters in the password field should be masked (e.g., displayed as asterisks or dots)

expected_results: Characters entered into the password field are replaced with masking characters (e.g., '********').

scenarios.name: Test Brute-Force Attack Prevention (Account Lockout)
scenarios.description: Verify that the system implements measures to prevent brute-force attacks by locking out an account after a certain number of failed login attempts.

steps.text: The user is on the login page at http://localhost:8000
The user attempts to log in with an existing username but an incorrect password for a defined number of times (e.g., 5 times)
The user attempts to log in with the correct username and correct password after the failed attempts
The login attempt with correct credentials should fail
An account lockout message should be displayed

expected_results: After 'failed_attempts' invalid login attempts for 'valid_user', the account is temporarily locked.
Subsequent login attempts with correct credentials for 'valid_user' are denied.
A message indicating account lockout is displayed.

scenarios.name: Login Page Load Time Under Normal Load
scenarios.description: Measure the time it takes for the login page to fully load and become interactive when a moderate number of concurrent users are accessing it.

steps.text: The performance testing tool is configured to simulate 100 concurrent users.
The simulated users access the login page at http://localhost:8000.
The login page should load and be interactive within 3 seconds.

expected_results: The login page's DOM content is fully loaded.
All interactive elements (input fields, buttons) are visible and responsive.
The average page load time is less than or equal to 3 seconds.

scenarios.name: Login Page Response Time Under Peak Load
scenarios.description: Assess the login page's response time when subjected to a high volume of concurrent users to identify potential bottlenecks.

steps.text: The performance testing tool is configured to simulate 500 concurrent users.
The simulated users access the login page at http://localhost:8000.
The login page should remain responsive, with load times not exceeding 8 seconds for 95% of users.

expected_results: The login page continues to load without significant errors.
The 95th percentile of page load times is below 8 seconds.
Server CPU and memory utilization remain within acceptable thresholds (e.g., below 80%).

scenarios.name: Login Form Submission Latency
scenarios.description: Measure the time taken for the login form to submit and for a response to be received under normal load conditions.

steps.text: A valid set of login credentials is prepared.
The performance testing tool is configured to simulate 50 concurrent users performing login actions.
Each simulated user submits the login form with the valid credentials on http://localhost:8000.
The form submission and response should complete within 2 seconds for 90% of submissions.

expected_results: The login submission is processed by the server.
A successful login response (or appropriate error message) is received.
The average time from form submission to receiving a response is less than 2 seconds.

scenarios.name: Login Page Resource Utilization
scenarios.description: Monitor the resource consumption (CPU, memory) of the server when the login page is accessed by a moderate number of concurrent users.

steps.text: The performance testing tool is configured to simulate 75 concurrent users accessing the login page.
The simulated users repeatedly access the login page at http://localhost:8000 over a 5-minute period.
The server's CPU utilization should not exceed 60% and memory utilization should not exceed 70%.

expected_results: Server CPU usage remains below 60% on average.
Server memory usage remains below 70% on average.
No memory leaks are detected during the test period.

scenarios.name: Login Page Scalability with Increasing Load
scenarios.description: Gradually increase the number of concurrent users accessing the login page to identify the performance breaking point and observe how response times degrade.

steps.text: The performance testing tool will gradually increase concurrent users from 50 to 500.
The simulated users access the login page at http://localhost:8000 with a ramp-up of 10 users every 30 seconds.
The average login page load time should remain below 5 seconds until 300 concurrent users, after which it can degrade gracefully up to 8 seconds at 500 users.

expected_results: Page load times remain consistent and acceptable up to 300 concurrent users.
As user load increases beyond 300, page load times increase progressively.
The system remains operational and does not crash up to 500 concurrent users, with load times not exceeding 8 seconds.

scenarios.name: Login with invalid credentials
scenarios.description: Test the login functionality when a user provides invalid username and password combination.

steps.text: I am on the login page at http://localhost:8000
I enter an invalid username and an invalid password
I click the login button
I should see an error message indicating invalid credentials
I should remain on the login page

expected_results: An error message like 'Invalid username or password' is displayed.
The user is not redirected to any authenticated page.
The input fields might be cleared or retain the invalid input.

scenarios.name: Login with empty username field
scenarios.description: Test the login functionality when the username field is left empty.

steps.text: I am on the login page at http://localhost:8000
I leave the username field empty
I enter a valid password
I click the login button
I should see a validation error message for the username field
I should remain on the login page

expected_results: A validation error message like 'Username is required' is displayed next to or near the username input.
The login attempt is prevented.
The user remains on the login page.

scenarios.name: Login with empty password field
scenarios.description: Test the login functionality when the password field is left empty.

steps.text: I am on the login page at http://localhost:8000
I enter a valid username
I leave the password field empty
I click the login button
I should see a validation error message for the password field
I should remain on the login page

expected_results: A validation error message like 'Password is required' is displayed next to or near the password input.
The login attempt is prevented.
The user remains on the login page.

scenarios.name: Login with both empty fields
scenarios.description: Test the login functionality when both username and password fields are left empty.

steps.text: I am on the login page at http://localhost:8000
I leave both the username and password fields empty
I click the login button
I should see validation error messages for both fields
I should remain on the login page

expected_results: Validation error messages for both 'Username is required' and 'Password is required' are displayed.
The login attempt is prevented.
The user remains on the login page.
